text: For some time, residents have been contacting my office with right of way concerns at the intersection of Denton and Robinson, and recently there was an accident there. Having spoken in person with many in the area, I've found there is overwhelming support for implementation of an all way stop control at this location. I am requesting installation of an all way stop control at the intersection of Denton Ave. and Robinson Ave.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized a compulsory all-way stop control at the intersection of Denton Avenue and Robinson Avenue.
